ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets fit my interest in polished ensemble singing and musical standards.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Expressive vocals and ballads appeal to the melodic side of my listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal focus interests me, but I would try Partners first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It looks like another vocal album I might enjoy, but the edition title is unclear and I would choose 25 first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Noel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Christmas listening suggests possible interest, but I am not seeking seasonal music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis: Ultimate Gospel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent listening does not establish an interest in gospel, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to expect the vocal or orchestral sound I want.
ItemID: NA; Title: 21 Number Ones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or track list, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my preferences.
ItemID: NA; Title: Home for Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Seasonal music has appealed before, but it is not what I want for this listening session.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The missing artist makes it hard to connect this compilation with music I enjoy.
